title: 1705. Maximum Number of Eaten Apples

examples.explanation: You can eat 7 apples: - On the first day, you eat an apple that grew on the first day. - On the second day, you eat an apple that grew on the second day. - On the third day, you eat an apple that grew on the second day. After this day, the apples that grew on the third day rot. - On the fourth to the seventh days, you eat apples that grew on the fourth day.

You can eat 5 apples: - On the first to the third day you eat apples that grew on the first day. - Do nothing on the fouth and fifth days. - On the sixth and seventh days you eat apples that grew on the sixth day.
